verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a cloud robotics platform like Viam, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside the Viam app. What it does show is that external AI agents can drive Viam through the shell, CLI or SDKs (viam-docs-12), and that the docs publish an llms.txt. Those cover outside agents operating Viam, not delegating tasks to an in-product assistant.
